Class BoardGameAreaController

java.lang.Object
view.board.BoardGameAreaController
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewController
public class BoardGameAreaController extends Object implements ViewController
Sub-controller for the board's central play area: opponents bar, card rows, offer track, turn order, and decks. Initialised by BoardViewController.bind(SceneRouter) after FXML injection.

    • rescale

      private void rescale()
      Called by init(SceneRouter, StackPane, BoardSelfPanelController). Listens to window resize and triggers a card-size recompute + re-render. Debounced at 120 ms to avoid flooding during live drag-resize.
